checkpoints.name: Recognise the usage limit in the worker stream: a structured usage_limit fact (rejected rate_limit_event, 429 error result, resetsAt) in the stream diagnosis, reason usage_limit above exit_status, outcome still FAILURE, with golden and negative-case tests replayed at worker exit 0 and 1

Classify the job: a limited job that moved nothing (phase, HEAD and tracked changes unchanged) is INTERRUPTED with usage_limit and UsageLimitReached in protocol and legacy mode and in resume; every other limited job is FAILED with the evidence; the tracked-change baseline is captured in the pre-state; usage accounting charges it as a job that ran

Wait and repeat: run waits for the reset plus grace through the C8 pause (usage_paused, no lock, bounded, with or without usage.enabled), repeats the step without counting it and stops after three limited attempts, with the two stop lines; step exits 17 and resume names the reset; INTERRUPTED without the fact maps to exit 40; lifecycle scenarios

Measure the first job after a window reset: reproduce the C8 review follow-up on the unchanged code, then baseline the new window so the delta is measured (the real behaviour is after_reset), or defer with the finding recorded
Documentation and roadmap: exit codes, common problems, run page, runtime and workers guides, C8b complete, check_docs, golden checks and the full suite green
